entities.summary: Viktor Petrovich Vlasov was a Russian basketball player who competed for the Soviet Union in the 1952 Summer Olympics. He was born in Moscow and served in the Soviet military in World War II. He was a member of the Soviet team, which won the silver medal. He trained at Dynamo in Moscow.
